raw_segments.text: A base, proud, shallow, beggarly, three-suited, hundred-pound, filthy,
A lily-livered, action-taking, horse-in, glass-gazing, super-serviceable,
One that wouldst be a baud in way of good service, and art nothing but the
composition of a knave, beggar, coward, pander, and the sun and air of a
One whom I will beat into clamorous whining.
If thou denyest the least syllable of thy addition.
